note: Window agent p1100-p1199 (Phase D). keyframe_overrides/0.. restore the years the dossiers' own notes state for a keyframe whose from/to were left out (the compiler then gives it the span of its Cliopatria row and unions it with the narrower keyframes that follow, so the old land stays); events: see each note.

region.text: Ibn Mardanish's realm at his death: Cliopatria's 1169 outline without Albarracín, the lands between Murcia and Valencia

events.note: 1172: the Almohads take Ibn Mardanish's whole realm. Page: 'In 1172 Murcia was taken by the Almohads'; 'The Moorish Taifa of Murcia included Albacete and part of Almería as well'. The taifa-of-murcia loss of 1172 covers the whole 1169 outline, but the compiler applies a loss as the counterpart's gain when the counterpart has one (here Murcia and Valencia only), so about 100 cells of the outline stayed with Murcia until 1228. This gain carries the rest of the same outline.

region.text: the part of the last Liao shape that no Jin shape holds: the Mongolian steppe and the Gobi (Dornogovi, Omnogovi, Dundgovi, western Inner Mongolia)

events.note: 26 March 1125: the Liao end with Tianzuo's capture, but the Jin took the Liao land of Manchuria and the Inner Mongolian frontier, not the steppe: 'the Jin sought to appease the northern nomads like the Mongols rather than to rule them directly' (Jin page, c. 1146-47). Without this loss the Liao dissolve (the last shape minus the Orkhon) hands the steppe to the Jin for a year and the Jin 1126 keyframe takes 3,991 cells back (the largest keyframe snap of the window); the land is nobody's from the Liao end.

region.text: the Bosnian part of the Hungarian 1147 shape that the 1169 shape (keyframe kingdom-of-hungary_1165) no longer holds

events.note: Added by the reviewer of p1100-p1199 to go with keyframe_overrides/6: once the 1147 shape stops at 1163, Hungary's keyframe 1165 drops these 64 Bosnian cells to nobody, and the Byzantine gain of 1167 (from Hungary) no longer finds them, so they were nobody's in 1165-1168. Page, 1165: 'A Byzantine army also occupied Dalmatia'; 'Dalmatia and Bosnia were soon converted into Byzantine themes'; the 1167 treaty 'confirmed the dominion of the Byzantine Empire over central Dalmatia, Bosnia and Syrmium'.

minus.text: Ghazni, Zabulistan and the Punjab, valid for 1152-1160 only, without the Iranian cells (1161 is keyframe ghaznavid-empire_1161, 1162-1176 is ghaznavid-empire_1162)
Haryana and Delhi, the Tomara country including Hansi and Thanesar

correction.text: Ghazni, Zabulistan and the Punjab, valid for 1152-1160 only, without the Iranian cells (1161 is keyframe ghaznavid-empire_1161, 1162-1176 is ghaznavid-empire_1162); without Haryana and Delhi

keyframe_overrides.why: The dossier's own note says the 1152 shape is right 'for 1152-1160 only'; page: 'In 1161/2, a group of Oghuz Turks seized the Ghaznavid capital of Ghazni, forcing Khusrau Malik to retreat to Lahore', and it names none of Kabul, Kandahar or Baluchistan for him ('as far as southern Kashmir'). from/to were left out, so the compiler gave the shape the years of its Cliopatria row (1152-1176) and unioned it with keyframes 1161 and 1162 (Lahore and the Punjab): the Ghaznavids kept about 3,100 Afghan and Baluchi cells to 1176. Now the keyframes 1161 and 1162 apply from 1161.

correction.text: Chernigov with the Murom-Ryazan lands: 'bequeathed the Principality of Chernigov to his second eldest surviving son, along with Murom' (Murom page)

keyframe_overrides.why: The dossier's own note: the Murom-Ryazan lands stay with Chernigov for 1094-1126 and keyframe _1127 carries the shape from then; page: 'In 1127, it became a separate principality and was known as the Principality of Murom-Ryazan'. Without from/to the wide shape (to 1235) stayed in the union with keyframe 1127 and kept the Murom-Ryazan cells for Chernigov to 1199.

The dossier's own note: the shape 'holds 1111-1114; new keyframes follow' (1115, 1120, 1122, 1124). Page: 'In the late autumn of 1114 Aguda attacked Ningjiang'; 'The Jin captured the Supreme Capital in mid-1120'; 'in the winter of 1121-22, he led Jin forces to capture the Central Capital'; 'the Jin took the Western Capital in the spring of 1122'; 'Tianzuo was captured in early 1125'. Without from/to the whole undivided Liao shape stayed in the union to 1125, beside the narrower keyframes.

correction.text: the 1139 shape plus the Oran-Tlemcen country and the southern Moroccan lands (Sous, Draa, Tafilalt with Sijilmasa) of the 1126 shape, held until 1144-1147

keyframe_overrides.why: The dossier's own note: 'Valid 1139-1143'; the single-year keyframes 1144-1148 and the 1149 keyframe follow. Page: the Almohads 'capture Tlemcen in 1144', took Oran in 1145 (Tashfin 'died in March 1145'), Fez 'in 1146' and Marrakesh 'in 1147'. Without from/to the shape (with the Oran-Tlemcen country and southern Morocco, about 3,200 cells) ran to 1151 and was unioned with each narrower keyframe.

The dossier's own note: the 1085 shape 'holds 1085-1100 only'; Vseslav died in 1101 (page: 'Vseslav (1044-1101)') and 'the principality was divided between his surviving sons' ('Polotsk was splintered between various smaller fiefs'); keyframe _1101 carries the reduced shape. Without from/to the old shape (with Latgale and Vilnius, 137 more cells) ran to 1110 and stayed in the union.

correction.text: the whole island, unchanged, for 1072-1110 only; the row's later years are replaced by the keyframes for 1111, 1153 and 1197

keyframe_overrides.why: The dossier's own note: 'Applies 1072-1110', the whole island while Vijayabahu I reigns; page: 'Vijayabahu I (1055-1110)', 'By 1070 ... he had reunited the country', and 'Parakramabahu I (1153-1186)' who 'established control over the island'. The keyframes _1111 (to 1152) and _1153 replace the outline, but without from/to the whole-island shape (Cliopatria years 1072-1249) stayed in the union and the kingdom held the whole island in 1111-1152 and 1197-1199.

The dossier's own note: 'This shape holds to 1163'. Page: the 1163 treaty let 'the Byzantines ... take possession of Bela's duchy'; 'A Byzantine army occupied Syrmium' (1164); 'A Byzantine army also occupied Dalmatia' (1165); 'On 8 July 1167, the Byzantine army annihilated the Hungarian troops in the Battle of Sirmium'; Bela 'reoccupied' Croatia, Dalmatia and Sirmium 'between 1180 and 1181'. Without from/to the 1147 shape (to 1168) stayed in the union with keyframes 1164 and 1165 and kept the lost Dalmatian cells.

The dossier's own note: the shape with Vengi 'ends in 1133, and 1134-1138 takes the base shape (new keyframe 1134)'. Page: 'By 1133 Vikrama Chola was able to re-capture Vengi from Vikramaditya VI's mild son Someshvara III'; 'After Vikramaditya's death in 1126, the Cholas began a slow process of encroachment over Vengi'. Without from/to the Vengi shape (to 1138) stayed in the union with keyframe 1134 and the size rule gave Vengi cells to the Chalukya against the Chola.

correction.text: unchanged shape; it holds 1188-1197, Bohemia becomes a kingdom in 1198

keyframe_overrides.why: The dossier's own note: 'The shape holds 1188-1197; 1198-1201 use the new keyframe holy-roman-empire_1198'. Page: Bohemia was 'raised to a kingdom in 1198'. Without from/to the 1188 shape (with Bohemia and Moravia) stayed in the union with keyframe 1198 and kept them in the Empire's claim in 1198-1199.
